/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/baadshah-husain.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
header, roman_and_body = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
lines = roman.decode()
for before, after in {
    'Baadshah': 'Baadshaah',
    'baadshah': 'baadshaah',
    'Shah': 'Shaah',
    'meiṅ': 'mein',
    'Maiṅ': 'Main',
    'karbobala': 'Karbobala',
    'Wallah': 'Wallaah',
    'rahegi': 'rahe gi',
    'karegi': 'kare gi',
    'uthegi': 'uthe gi',
    'sunegi': 'sune gi',
}.items():
    lines = re.sub(r'\\b' + before + r'\\b', after, lines)
header = header.replace(b'alternateTitle: \"Baadshah Husain\"', b'alternateTitle: \"Baadshaah Husain\"')
roman_blocks = lines.strip().split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source_blocks]
for number, digit in enumerate('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷', 1):
    assert next(i for i,b in enumerate(roman_blocks) if b.splitlines()[0].strip() == str(number)) == next(i for i,b in enumerate(source_blocks) if b.splitlines()[0] == digit)
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in lines)
updated = header + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + lines.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print(f'{len(source_blocks)} aligned blocks, {sum(len(b.splitlines()) for b in source_blocks)-7} verse lines')
PY"
